common.tagline: Volcanic forge-world of fire rivers and Imperial mining concerns.
common.government: Imperial mining concession; pre-Imperial Mustafarian clans tolerated
hyperlanes: Mustafar spur off the Triellus Trade Route
common.famousFor: Lava-mined ores, ancient Sith ruins (officially denied), and a black tower no one is permitted to ask about.
common.cantinaReputation: Hellscape of lava rivers and volcanic eruptions. Darth Vader's fortress looms over the molten surface. In 15 BBY, the mining operations continue under heavy Imperial security. Nobody comes here voluntarily — if you crash-land on Mustafar, the lava is the least of your problems.
